description: Audit 2026-11-03 (docs/audits/AUDIT_2026-11-03.md) H3. tools/jobs_hooks.py:257-336 checks that evidence exists, not that it is genuine: 20 copies of one ledger line pass, and acc_exempt exempts all of harness/acceptance/, so a branch that edits only baseline.json (thresholds, deterministic: false) needs no passes.
